audit.why: Chart, phases and content agree: Caitlyn favoured levels 1 through first item, Tristana flips ahead at 2+ items once her per-level range catches up.

Spikes correctly key the early short-range window, level 6 Ace in the Hole punishing a caught Rocket Jump, first-item poke advantage, and the late flip once her passive range growth and jump resets come online.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns only discusses Rocket Jump and never states that Buster Shot (R) roots and can cancel Caitlyn's Ace in the Hole channel.
audit.why: Flagged in missingInteractions as your-channel-punished — Tristana's R interrupts Caitlyn's channeled R just like any hard CC.
audit.corrected: Added the Buster Shot CD and channel-cancel warning to breakdown.cooldowns.
